<SYSTEM>This is the full developer documentation for Enya</SYSTEM>

# Welcome to Enya

> AI-Native Observability Editor

# Enya Documentation

[Section titled “Enya Documentation”](#enya-documentation)

A keyboard-first multi-tool editor that brings together code, observability, databases, and terminals.

## Built for Builders

[Section titled “Built for Builders”](#built-for-builders)

Enya is designed for the engineers writing the code, instrumenting metrics, responding to pages, and debugging production issues. Navigate your entire stack like you navigate code—with vim-style keybindings, a command palette, and workspaces defined in TOML.

## Get Started

[Section titled “Get Started”](#get-started)

* **[Getting Started](/docs/getting-started/introduction/)** — Install, connect, and start exploring
* **[Keyboard Reference](/docs/editor/keyboard-reference/)** — Complete keyboard shortcuts guide

# Keyboard Reference

> Complete keyboard shortcut reference for Enya

Enya uses vim-style keybindings. This page provides a complete reference of all available shortcuts.

## Navigation

[Section titled “Navigation”](#navigation)

| Key              | Action              |
| ---------------- | ------------------- |
| `h`/`j`/`k`/`l`  | Move between panes  |
| `Ctrl+w h/j/k/l` | Move focus to split |
| `Tab`            | Next pane           |
| `Shift+Tab`      | Previous pane       |

## Pane Management

[Section titled “Pane Management”](#pane-management)

| Key  | Action                             |
| ---- | ---------------------------------- |
| `x`  | Close focused pane                 |
| `m`  | Maximize focused pane              |
| `F`  | Toggle fullscreen for focused pane |
| `Z`  | Toggle zen mode (hide chrome)      |
| `e`  | Edit focused pane                  |
| `cv` | Cycle visualization type           |
| `yy` | Share/yank focused pane            |

## Finder and Search

[Section titled “Finder and Search”](#finder-and-search)

| Key       | Action                                         |
| --------- | ---------------------------------------------- |
| `Space+f` | Open unified finder (metrics, alerts, commits) |
| `:`       | Open command palette                           |
| `?`       | Show keyboard shortcuts                        |

## Go-To Commands

[Section titled “Go-To Commands”](#go-to-commands)

| Key  | Action             |
| ---- | ------------------ |
| `gd` | Go to definition   |
| `ga` | Go to alert        |
| `gf` | Float focused pane |

## Time Range Presets

[Section titled “Time Range Presets”](#time-range-presets)

Press `t` followed by a key:

| Key   | Action            |
| ----- | ----------------- |
| `t 5` | Last 5 minutes    |
| `t 1` | Last 15 minutes   |
| `t 3` | Last 30 minutes   |
| `t h` | Last 1 hour       |
| `t 6` | Last 6 hours      |
| `t d` | Last 24 hours     |
| `t w` | Last 7 days       |
| `t c` | Custom time range |

## Leader Keys (Space)

[Section titled “Leader Keys (Space)”](#leader-keys-space)

| Key       | Action                     |
| --------- | -------------------------- |
| `Space+f` | Open unified finder        |
| `Space+a` | Open/focus agent panel     |
| `Space+d` | Toggle diagnostics overlay |
| `Space+h` | Show home page             |
| `Space+b` | Toggle project sidebar     |
| `Space+p` | Open plugins overlay       |
| `Space+t` | Open time range picker     |

## Visual Multi-Select

[Section titled “Visual Multi-Select”](#visual-multi-select)

| Key             | Action                    |
| --------------- | ------------------------- |
| `Ctrl+v`        | Enter visual-multi mode   |
| `v` or `Escape` | Exit visual-multi mode    |
| `j`/`k`         | Extend selection          |
| `x`             | Close all selected        |
| `e`             | Multi-edit selected panes |
| `r`             | Refresh all selected      |
| `yy`            | Share selected panes      |

## Window Movement

[Section titled “Window Movement”](#window-movement)

| Key                | Action                             |
| ------------------ | ---------------------------------- |
| `Ctrl+w h/j/k/l`   | Move pane in direction             |
| `Ctrl+w t h/j/k/l` | Merge pane into tabs with neighbor |

## Other

[Section titled “Other”](#other)

| Key      | Action                   |
| -------- | ------------------------ |
| `ct`     | Cycle through themes     |
| `u`      | Undo last action         |
| `Escape` | Clear focus / exit modal |

## Command Palette

[Section titled “Command Palette”](#command-palette)

Press `:` to open the command palette.

| Command              | Alias  | Action                                   |
| -------------------- | ------ | ---------------------------------------- |
| `:version`           |        | Show version and build info              |
| `:split <h/v>`       | `sp`   | Split view (horizontal/vertical)         |
| `:vsplit`            | `vs`   | Vertical split                           |
| `:quit`              | `q`    | Quit workspace                           |
| `:write`             | `w`    | Save workspace                           |
| `:settings`          | `set`  | Open settings (AI, styling, connections) |
| `:screenshot [path]` | `ss`   | Take a screenshot                        |
| `:share`             |        | Share workspace as URL                   |
| `:terminal`          | `term` | Open a terminal pane (native only)       |
| `:sql`               |        | Open a SQL pane (native only)            |
| `:trace [id]`        | `tr`   | Open a tracing pane                      |
| `:logs`              | `log`  | Open a logs pane                         |
| `:float`             | `fl`   | Float focused pane                       |
| `:dock`              | `dk`   | Dock all floating panes                  |
| `:tutorial`          | `tut`  | Open interactive tutorial                |
| `:sync git`          |        | Sync git operations (native only)        |

## Agent Input

[Section titled “Agent Input”](#agent-input)

When typing in the agent panel:

| Key | Action           |
| --- | ---------------- |
| `@` | Mention a metric |

# Getting Started

> Get started with Enya in minutes

# Getting Started

[Section titled “Getting Started”](#getting-started)

Neovim meets Grafana, reimagined for human and agent collaboration. Enya is a keyboard-first multi-tool editor that brings together code, metrics, logs, traces, SQL, and terminals in one interface.

## Key Features

[Section titled “Key Features”](#key-features)

* **Multi-Tool** — Code, metrics, logs, traces, SQL, terminals — all in one interface
* **AI Native** — Agents have access to the same commands you do (Codex, Claude via ACP)
* **Codebase-Aware** — Jump from observability data to source code with tree-sitter
* **Keyboard-Driven** — Neovim-inspired navigation with vim keybindings
* **Extensible** — Lua plugins and fully customizable

## Download

[Section titled “Download”](#download)

Download Enya from [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/meldrumlabs/enya/releases/latest):

* **[macOS](https://github.com/meldrumlabs/enya/releases/latest/download/Enya.dmg)** — macOS 10.15 or later
* **[Try in Browser](/editor)** — No install required (WASM)

Or build from source with `cargo build --release`.

## Panes

[Section titled “Panes”](#panes)

Everything in Enya lives in a pane — metrics, logs, traces, SQL queries, and terminals. Panes tile automatically in an i3-style layout with splits and tabs.

## Basic Navigation

[Section titled “Basic Navigation”](#basic-navigation)

Enya uses vim-style navigation:

| Key             | Action                                 |
| --------------- | -------------------------------------- |
| `h`/`j`/`k`/`l` | Move focus between panes               |
| `:`             | Open command palette                   |
| `Space+f`       | Open finder (metrics, alerts, commits) |
| `?`             | Show all keyboard shortcuts            |
| `e`             | Edit focused pane                      |
